reviews.title: Not as advertised
reviews.comment: Added these two 8gb sticks to the two open bays for a total of 32gb’s of RAM. Says speed of 3200mhz but when installed in an HP Omen 40L w/ the i7 shows 2400mhz. The factory two 8gb’s RAM show 3200mhz which is what I wanted. False advertising obviously. I went into the BIOS and over clocked to 3200mhz but still shows all four only running at 2400. 👎🏻
reviews.author: Steven R.
